Ring 3

Ring 3 is where the shell, the web engine and the search client run. The kernel keeps the privileged operations.

A window is a rectangle with one shared title bar. Close, minimize and maximize are the same three buttons on a web page and on the editor.

Text scale is a quarter step. The command text-size sets a slot, and the slot covers the web view, the chat, the shell, a pane, the editor and the first app window.

This post is the content root because its class is post-content. The masthead and the related list are not.

What stays partial

The battery is simulated. The estimator is a laboratory model. The phase-3 browser is not complete: there is still no JavaScript.

An EDID block read at boot describes the QEMU display. A real monitor's DDC bus is not driven.
